captures.name: static-fallback-1440.png
captures.provenance: Recorded run of the glacier model, sandstone. Simplified model; time is compressed.
captures.textAlternative: Fig. 1: Line drawing of a block of mountains cut open at the front. A glacier fills the upper valley from a bowl-shaped cirque below the peaks down to its snout. Under the glacier the valley is a broad U with steep sides. Below the snout a meltwater river runs on through a narrower V-shaped valley with conifers on its lower slopes. The front face shows the rock in section.
